description: POST a company domain or ticker. Returns cited firmographics: name, legal name, industry, founded year, employees, HQ, country, tickers, SIC, latest annual report and revenue, LEI and company socials, each field with a source URL. Sources: company homepage, Wikidata, SEC EDGAR. No personal contacts. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].

domain.description: Company domain or homepage URL, for example stripe.com

includeSec.description: Add SEC EDGAR filer facts and reported revenue

ticker.description: Optional US ticker, for example MSFT. Use instead of or with domain

name: company_facts
title: Johto Data Company Facts
